newsitem.title: GERMANY: GOLF-MIST CAUSES TWO-HOUR DELAY TO THIRD-ROUND START.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MIST CAUSES TWO-HOUR DELAY TO THIRD-ROUND START.

text.p: Early-morning mist delayed the start of the third round of the German Masters golf tournament for nearly two hours on Saturday.
Britain's Paul Broadhurst seized an early lead. He birdied the fourth hole, dropped a shot at the fifth and then went birdie-birdie-eagle to take the outright lead at 13 under par.
At that point, Broadhurst was one shot ahead Darren Clarke, Peter Mitchell, Mark Davis, Peter Baker, Michael Campbell, Greg Turner and Padraig Harrington.
Colin Montgomerie, who needs to finish in the top 40 in this event to become the European number one for the fourth successive year, was a further shot back.
